_comment: Tolley Brand. The Lease's old tenant. Apologises for things nobody mentioned. Very good with seeds. Very bad with endings.

lines.text: You've had— you've had HARVESTS? From my plots? Plural? Oh. Oh, I'm so sorry. I mean I'm so proud. I always get those two mixed up.
Pale fungus. Grows in the dark. Doesn't like being looked at. I look at it anyway. Sorry. I say sorry to it as well, which helps nobody.
The Lease looks better than when I left it. I left it in a bit of a state. I left everything in a bit of a state. Sorry.
My sister used to say I'd apologise to a rock for standing on it. I do, now. Knappers like it. Grist says it's good manners. Grist is the only one who's ever said so.

intro.say: Oh no. You're from Wick. You've got the look. And a Wick lamp. And that's— is that a Wick tiller on your belt? That's MY tiller. Isn't it.
Tolley. Tolley Brand. I had the Lease. The plots at the west end. I left. Very suddenly. Without telling anyone. Sorry.
Is the seed tin still there? It's a good tin. I labelled everything. Did you find the labels? I'm sorry about the labels. I write very small when I'm sad.

choice.text: I found the tin. Glowbeets grew.
Barnaby said you went down-line and didn't need it.

intro.say: They GREW? In the plots? Oh. Oh, good. Oh, I'm going to have to sit down. I'm sitting. Sorry.
He said that? 'Doesn't need it'? That's... that's the kindest thing Barnaby has ever said about me. Usually he says I owe him a spanner. I do owe him a spanner.
My sister. The damp winter. After, the Lease was too quiet, and the plots were too full of things she'd planted.

I heard there were stations below that the Breath still reached. I thought I'd find one and not have to explain anything to anybody. I found Sallow. They didn't ask me to explain. I've been explaining ever since. To the fungus.

home.say: You've got the lift running. Up and down. Every day if you wanted.
I've been thinking. Only a bit. Only all the time.

choice.text: Come home, Tolley. The Lease has a cot.

home.say: ...Home. Yes. I'll come up and sleep on my own cot in my own Lease and apologise to my own plots. You can keep the bed. You've earned the bed.
I'll tell Pell. Pell will cry. Pell cries at everything. It's lovely. I'll be up tomorrow.
...You're right. The fungus would never forgive me. And Pell can't grow anything that isn't a pump. I'll stay. For now. Sorry. I mean thank you.

back.say: Look at it. The Lease. The plots. The fence I never fixed. You fixed the fence. Sorry. Thank you. Both.
I went to the Lantern House and Mags hit me with a ladle and then hugged me and then hit me again. That's Wick for you. I'd forgotten how much I liked being hit with a ladle.
I'll take the cot. And I'll take the morning watering, if you'll have me. I'm good with the morning. It's endings I'm bad at.
